descriptionChirho: Qal participle used substantively to denote an infant or young child still nursing at the breast.
Qal finite verb describing the action of an infant or person sucking milk from the breast.
Hifil participle used substantively to denote a woman who suckles or nurses a child, often a professional wet-nurse.
Hifil finite verb and infinitive describing the causative action of a woman giving suck to or nursing a child.
